_comment: SYNTHETIC, written by hand around the SHAPE of a Whole Foods strip — no card digits, no cashier, no phone number, because the repo is public. Two photos overlapping one line, and the seam falls between an item and its count sub-row: the PLAIN SKYR ends photo one and `Qty 1 $2.39 ea` opens photo two. Five skyr lines counted 2/4/4/2/1; two by-weight lines whose sub-row says `Qty` and is a WEIGHT, not a count; and a bag charge with no money on its own line, priced only in the totals block. The lines come to the printed $59.66.
